county_relationship.note: Counties derived from the county on each facility's source record. A ZIP can span several counties; HUD USPS crosswalk not yet configured.

top_violation_types.title: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Have Coverage of at Least $300,000 For Each Occurrence of Negligence (26 TAC §742.403((1)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has not responded to multiple attempts regarding liability insurance.

top_violation_types.title: Substitutes, volunteers, and contractors counted in ratio (26 TAC §746.1401(c))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: It was determined that an individual was assisting with children and counted in ratio without the proper qualifications.

top_violation_types.title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One food allergy plan was not signed by the parent.

top_violation_types.title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment -Provides Sufficient Walking and Work Space (26 TAC §746.2909(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Cots for napping were arranged next to each other in a way that did not allow for children nor caregivers to walk in between without stepping on cots to get to walkway.

top_violation_types.title: Documented Annual Training - 6 Hours of annual training required (26 TAC §746.1309(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A staff person was missing 6 hours of annual training.

top_violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The infants did not have infant feeding instructions available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions (26 TAC §746.5625(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The electronic child safety alarm was observed not functioning in one of the operation's vans used to transport the children in care.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.
